Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mamai'chɨk gu oidha' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' dhi' ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨx pai' xikoolh.

Jano' ba' dhi' ka't na ba' xidhuu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam xikoolh; gio ba' mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam xidhuu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ dhi' gu oidha' ka't na ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam xidhuu guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka' pai' na ba' gu vaak pai' jix bhaan na ba' xidhuu.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ka't na ba' gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak gu maa'nkar bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix duu.

Jano' ba' na ba' gu maa'nkar kiicham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vupui bhaan jix ai'chdhix na ba' xidhuu; gio ba' ka't na ba' bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gɨ'kora' ja'tkam ka't ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa xidhuu baasɨ'n ju'ñdharan gu maa'nkar kiicham vupui bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa xidhuu vupui bhaan gu maa'nkar kiicham dɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan tas gei'ñ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan tas buusñi; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't baasɨ'n dɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tas gei'ñ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tas buusñi.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu maa'nkar gu Israeel cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ chiñia' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu oidha' gu vaak gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ñi'ook chiñia' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tɨtda:―Cha'pim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx bhai' gu Epa bɨx bhai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨx bhai' gui'x.

Jano' ba' gu Epa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; na guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Epa; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ baasɨ'n gu Epa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tiriik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ baasɨ'n gu Epa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kai' vaas.

Jano' ba' jir bɨx bhai' bɨ'ñdhatu' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; na gu' mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' ali' karneer guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Israeel na ba' gu maa'nkar na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu maa'nkar na ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Israeel.

Gu' gu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tuur cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ xidhuu.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vaak bhaan maakobh guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kiki'ñgob guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix duu kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vaak.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gui'x gakdhi'ñchix guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' jugi gu takarui' cham jabka'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gɨ'kora' ja'tkam maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' tuur guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios kɨɨv ali' vaakax kɨɨv gu chuukug cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu tanoolh kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm uañi'ñ gu chio'ñ chiiw gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx tuur guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Epa bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Epa; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Epa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨ'ñdhatu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kɨɨv guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ja'p dhi' ja'tkam kɨɨv gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨ'ñdhatu'.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tas buusñi guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh tu jiim gu tanoolh juanda' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr bhi'spio'kai gio gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu masad.

Jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ki'ñgob guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ki'ñgob guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duu maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ba'k ki'ñgob; gio ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gu' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ki'ñgob bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ba'k ki'ñgob guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gɨ'kora' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh juanda' ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ali' karneer cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Epa bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx mar kaneer guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu novɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨ'ñdhatu' bɨɨx gu Epa.

Gu' gu' gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu masad tuur cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ali' karneer gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Epa bɨɨx tuur gu Epa bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gu' bɨɨx ali' karneer jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Epa.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gɨ'kora' ja'tkam ba'k guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ki'ñgob; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk gu ja'tkam gu oidha' ba'k vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ba'k guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ki'ñgob saagi'ñ; gio ba' ba'k guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ki'ñgob saagi'ñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ki'ñgob guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' chɨbiapui guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk gɨ'kora' ja'tkam na pai' dhuuk ba'k guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Epa bɨɨx tuur gu Epa bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx ali' karneer guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨ'ñdhatu' bɨɨx gu Epa.

Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk gɨ'kora' ja'tkam namkidhat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios bhi'spio'kai ki'ñgob guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tas buusñi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ja'p guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu tanoolh juanda'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ki'ñgob mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh maa'nkar tai bhaan mar kaneer oidha' tas cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu xibh maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ baasɨ'n gu Epa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ baasɨ'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨ'ñdhatu' na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ñi'ook kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios mar kaneer guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨ'ñdhatu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu maa'nkar oi'ñdha' gu ma'nkam ka't; mi' dhɨr gu maa'nkar ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Gu' gu' tu' gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ oi'ñdha' tu duukam ka't bɨɨx ka'm oidha' tas guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham tu jiim gu maa'nkar; gio ba' bia'ka' maa'n guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam; na ba' gu ja'tkam cham ka't baas maa'n gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ba'k ka't bhaan ki'ñgob jix duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't pai' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tas gei'ñ.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' pai' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu maa'nkar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm uañi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham jix buusñi guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix buusñi guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm maakobh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't naadat.

Jano' ba' maakobh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tɨtda:―Aañ oo'm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' ko'kmarak guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx maakobh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga xikoolh bɨx maakobh guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga xikoolh guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix duu pai' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu maa'nkar gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ba'k gu vaak; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨtaa'n guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak bhaan tas buusñi; na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak ka't tas buusñi; jano' ba' gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨtaa'n bhaan guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix duu gu vaak saagi'ñ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix duu jix buusñi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt ki'ñgob guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt mai' ki'ñgob guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mai' gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tas buusñi; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix duu.

Jano' ba' gamai' gu chio'ñ bhaan tas buusñi ga'ra' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu novɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx gɨ' tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm kɨkbok; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx gɨ' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx gɨ' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; na gu' gu suudai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' buupui gu mar gu chio'ñ mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ka't gu u'u guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mui'x baasɨ'n.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' gu suudai' gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tas buusñi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jɨjɨkgɨm gu gɨ' suudai'; mi' dhɨr ba'k gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' ka't bɨx gu i'ii'ñ na jix do'ig guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ba'k dhi' ja'tkam gook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ii'mdagaram; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mui'x gu vatop guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat kia'mi'ñ dhi' gu suudai' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr ii'mdagaram bɨx ba'k dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' ka't ju'ñdharan no'm bhibhiadam; gio ba' dɨr gu En-gadi bɨɨx ka'm gu En-eglaim ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ a'sak; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu gɨ' suudai' jix jai'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ baasɨ'n guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨx gu u'u jugi; gio ba' jajar cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu i'bhɨ; na gu' masaa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na gu' gu suudai' gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ xidhuu; jano' ba' gu i'bhɨ ka't na ba' jugi jajar na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dhi' gu oidha' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu oidha' gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu Josee gook guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na ja'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu novɨ ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tattat; na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam dhi' gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu oidha' bhaan baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' dɨr gu gɨ' suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu etlon bai'ñpu' gu Sedad.
Jano' ba' gu amat gu Berota gu Sibraim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Damasko gu oidha' gu amat; gio ba' gu aser-attikon pai' gu auran.

Jano' ba' ka't gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dɨr gu gɨ' suudai' gu aser-enon gu oidha' gu Damasko guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn pai' gu amat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tas buusñi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu auran gu Damasko gu Galaad gu oidha' gu Israeel gu Jordaan; gio ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' tas buusñi.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim saagi'ñ bhaan saagi'ñ dɨr gu Tamar bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' dɨr gu Kades guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai'; mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tas gei'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' ka't gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm jix duu na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu amat; gio ba' dhi' ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tas gei'ñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios dhi' gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan mamai'chɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' jix duu guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gui'x na ja'p guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mamai'chɨk bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na ba' jix duu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' ka't bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ja'tkam mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu maa'nkar tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bopxi'ñ; gio ba' dɨr guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu etlon bai'ñpu' gu amat gu aser-enon gu oidha' gu Damasko guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu oidha' gu amat; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Dan baasɨ'n guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tas buusñi tas gei'ñ.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu oidha' gu Dan dɨr baasɨ'n tas buusñi bɨɨx ka'm baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu Aser baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu oidha' gu Aser dɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu Neptalii.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu oidha' gu Neptalii dɨr baasɨ'n tas buusñi bɨɨx ka'm baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu Manasees.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu oidha' gu Manasees dɨr baasɨ'n tas buusñi bɨɨx ka'm baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu oidha' gu Epraim dɨr baasɨ'n tas buusñi bɨɨx ka'm baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu Rubeen.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu oidha' gu Rubeen dɨr baasɨ'n tas buusñi bɨɨx ka'm baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu oidha' gu Judaa dɨr baasɨ'n tas buusñi bɨɨx ka'm baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ja'p no'x guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios maachim dɨr baasɨ'n tas buusñi bɨɨx ka'm baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' xidhuu guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam abhaar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ tas gei'ñ mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tas buusñi guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim saagi'ñ; gio ba' xidhuu gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Na pai' dhuuk jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ma'nkam gu Sadok guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Lebitas.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' baasɨ'n guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ju'ñdharan gu oidha' gu Lebitas.

Jano' ba' gu Lebitas guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' bɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' bhaan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu oidha'; na gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jixchamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ na ba' kiicham na ba' ba'bhak na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' kiicham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' dhi' ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; gio ba' baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam baasɨ'n saagi'ñ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ baasɨ'n tas buusñi maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ baasɨ'n tas gei'ñ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kiicham ka't guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam saagi'ñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx tas buusñi guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios mambhɨɨx tas gei'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam abhaar mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tas buusñi mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' tas gei'ñ ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam abhaar ka't na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kiicham.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kiicham ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' xidhuu na ba' gu maa'nkar kiicham.

Jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam abhaar gu maa'nkar kiicham maachim vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tas gei'ñ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu ñi'ook ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam abhaar ka't; mi' dhɨr xidhuu gu vaak guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' dɨr gu maa'nkar gu Lebitas dɨr gu maa'nkar kiicham tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Judaa gu oidha' gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gɨ'kora' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bopxi'ñ dɨr baasɨ'n tas buusñi bɨɨx ka'm baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Benjamiin baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu oidha' gu Benjamiin dɨr baasɨ'n tas buusñi bɨɨx ka'm baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu Simeoon.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu oidha' gu Simeoon dɨr baasɨ'n tas buusñi bɨɨx ka'm baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu Issakâr.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu oidha' gu Issakâr dɨr baasɨ'n tas buusñi bɨɨx ka'm baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu Sabuloon.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu oidha' gu Sabuloon dɨr baasɨ'n tas buusñi bɨɨx ka'm baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu Gad.

Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu oidha' gu Gad baasɨ'n guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam saagi'ñ ka't gu oidha' dɨr gu Tamar bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dɨr gu Kades guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu oidha' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mamai'chɨk gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu Israeel dhi' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kiicham baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' kiki'ñgob kiicham ka't bhaan guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel; gio ba' vaik kiki'ñgob guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; mi' dhɨr ki'ñgob gu Rubeen; jano' ba' ki'ñgob gu Judaa; gio ba' ki'ñgob gu Lebii.

Jano' ba' baasɨ'n tas buusñi maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vaik kiki'ñgob; gio ba' ki'ñgob gu Josee; mi' dhɨr ki'ñgob gu Benjamiin; jano' ba' ki'ñgob gu Dan.

Jano' ba' baasɨ'n saagi'ñ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vaik kiki'ñgob; gio ba' ki'ñgob gu Simeoon; mi' dhɨr ki'ñgob gu Issakâr; jano' ba' ki'ñgob gu Sabuloon.

Jano' ba' baasɨ'n tas gei'ñ maakobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vaik kiki'ñgob; gio ba' ki'ñgob gu Gad; mi' dhɨr ki'ñgob gu Aser; jano' ba' ki'ñgob gu Neptalii.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' kiicham dɨr mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh ka't gu Jeobaa-samma.
